component.name: Chatpane
component.summary: Unofficial desktop app for Facebook Messenger

description.p: Chatpane wraps Messenger in a small native desktop window and removes the surrounding Facebook feed, Reels, Marketplace, and other distractions.
It provides native notifications, unread indicators, keyboard shortcuts, system theme integration, privacy controls, and a system tray.
A Facebook account is required. Voice and video calls are not yet available on Linux. Chatpane is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta.

description.p: The app has a new name, Chatpane, and a home at chatpane.app. Updating keeps your login, settings, and themes.
Chatpane now speaks 30 languages, lets you choose the notification sound, exports a chat from the chat list, and follows the tiled or floating state of windows on Linux tiling window managers.
Added the Pink, Lavender, Sage, Slate, and Terminal color themes, and fixed the first click in a Settings window opened in the background.

Redesigned Settings with a theme gallery, custom themes, accent colors, message fonts, and alternate app icons. Added right-click menus for messages and conversations, resizable panes, and conversation export to HTML or JSON.
Voice and video calls start again on macOS and Windows. On Linux, hovering the call buttons now explains why calls are not yet available.
File attachments such as PDFs, office documents, and archives download again, and failed downloads explain why.
Stopped repeated notifications for messages that were already announced, and updated Tauri with security fixes.
Recovered Messenger's background connection on macOS after a network outage.
Kept the layout inside the window when zooming in, and kept muted conversations quiet when they have unread messages.
Stopped old messages from triggering notifications after a reload, and fixed repeated reloads when the chat connection stalls.
Added thumbs-up reactions and eight-hour mutes directly from message notifications, and fixed stuck unread counts.
Recovered automatically from Messenger's fatal reconnect dialog and long sleeps, and released memory from long-running sessions.
Repaired Messenger connection failures in the background and recovered blank or frozen windows. Added scheduled messages that persist across restarts.
Recovered chats when the encrypted-message connection stays disconnected, and improved Facebook login layouts and Linux notification avatars.
Improved recovery when Messenger stops responding or limits requests, and added clearer camera and microphone troubleshooting.
Restored native desktop menus and improved Linux Wayland startup.
Completed Linux desktop integration and cut Messenger memory and CPU use.
Improved Messenger reliability and reduced Linux WebKit memory use.
Fixed notification hydration and conversation routing.
Added stronger privacy, notification, and desktop integration controls.
Expanded native desktop behavior and Messenger page integration.
First stable Chatpane release.
